notes: Mechanism-level zero-flip prediction. The five rechains rewrite the affected names on BOTH the clause side (annotations_ext_v1_merged.json atoms/by_clause/vocabulary) and the query side (behavior_atoms_audit_v1.json: must_preserve_user_agency__user in avoiding-over-and-under-caution's selection) in the same migration, so exact-name matching is preserved end to end; the vocabulary keys move with their clause lists, and the m0271 fold only merges usage counts into an existing key. Thresholds are pinned to thresholds_frozen.json (first use of the driver's config.thresholds support), so no cut can drift. Therefore the diff should be a NO-OP or zero flips; empty expected_directions is the honest zero-flip target. ANY flip falsifies this and is a finding: an unknown load-bearing name or a threshold-path discrepancy.
